website_detail_fields.index_note: Index feeds may not provide meaningful volume; do not synthesize it.

notes: The website market-data universe is intentionally not an all-stock universe.
No delisted-stock dataset is required for this website scope.
QQQ tracks Nasdaq-100; Nasdaq Composite is a separate broad Nasdaq market index.
Nasdaq-100 excludes financial companies, so its sector system is not equivalent to the S&P 500 11-sector ETF family.
Dow Jones sector views should use the broader Dow Jones U.S. Sector Index family, not pretend the 30-stock DJIA has a complete sector ETF family.
Provider-specific symbols are adapter details and must not redefine the canonical instrument IDs above.
